notes.title: Release day update
notes.content:
After watching many streams of the game and gathering feedback, here are the changes I added:

-Made the tutorial/guide visible from the start
-Closed off areas where no anomalies occur
-Reduced ambient sounds
-Added background music

Hoping these changes will provide a better experience 🙂
